:::{#sol-prereq-log-power}

The value is 15.
Since $8 = 2^3$,
$8^5 = \paren{2^3}^5 = 2^{15}$,
and the logarithm to the base 2 of $2^{15}$ is 15.

To review logarithms,
read the definition of [a logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/recurrences-growth.html#def-logarithm)
and the rule for [a logarithm of a power](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#thm-log-exp).

:::
